:::{#cor-moore-penrose-gram}
#### The Moore-Penrose inverse from the Gram matrix

For every $m \times n$ [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$,

$$
\matr{A}^+ = (\tp{\matr{A}}\matr{A})^+\,\tp{\matr{A}}.
$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
(\tp{\matr{A}}\matr{A})^+\,\tp{\matr{A}}
&= \matr{A}^+\,\tp{(\matr{A}^+)}\,\tp{\matr{A}}
&& \text{(@thm-moore-penrose-gram)}
\\
&= \matr{A}^+\,\tp{(\matr{A}\matr{A}^+)}
&& \text{(@thm-transpose-product)}
\\
&= \matr{A}^+\matr{A}\matr{A}^+
&& \text{(condition 3 of @def-moore-penrose)}
\\
&= \matr{A}^+.
&& \text{(condition 2 of @def-moore-penrose)}
\ea
$$

:::
